title: ScriptBreak payment record
description: One payment session. 'features' go into the model; scenario_id, workflow and label never do.

record.workflow: genuine | genuine_lookalike | digital_arrest | customer_care | kyc_official | courier | voice_clone | hang_up_and_pay | sent_by_mistake | chat_task (evaluation only)
record.label: 1 = scam scenario, 0 = genuine (from the generated scenario, never from rules)

features.median_90d: int, user's median payment over 90 days (0 = no history)
features.payments_90d: int, number of payments in 90 days
features.call_now: bool, a phone/internet call is active during this payment
features.call_seen_30m: bool, a call was active while the app was open in the last 30 min
features.screen_share: bool, screen sharing/recording or a remote-access app is active
features.payee_status: known | new | recent (first paid < 7 days ago) | warned (paid after an earlier Pause/Critical) | flagged (bank fraud report)
features.same_payee_24h: int, earlier payments to this new/recent payee in 24 h
features.new_payees_60m: int, earlier payments to OTHER new payees in 60 min
features.sent_new_24h: int, rupees already sent to new/recent payees in 24 h
features.credit_unknown_48h: int, rupees received from a never-transacted sender in 48 h (0 = none)
features.payee_is_sender: bool, this payee is the person who sent that money
features.payee_pasted: bool, payee UPI ID was pasted, not picked
features.app_switch: bool, user left the app and came back during the payment

not_model_inputs.q1: answer to 'Were you told this payment is needed to verify, protect or release your money?' (safety layer only)
not_model_inputs.q2: answer to 'Has anyone asked you to keep this payment secret from your family or bank?' (safety layer only)
